geography: United States (Travere net product sales of FILSPARI)
moa: Dual endothelin type A and angiotensin II type 1 receptor antagonist

launch_evidence.quote: FILSPARI became commercially available in the U.S. beginning the week of February 27, 2023, and we are providing a comprehensive patient support program throughout the patient's treatment journey.

search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 1438533 (Travere Therapeutics) via data.sec.gov/submissions; fetched the exhibits of every 8-K/8-K/A with item 2.02 and every 10-Q/10-K filed 2023-03 to 2026-09.

Rows read from the 'FILSPARI' line under 'Net product sales' in the consolidated statements of operations of each quarterly earnings release (8-K Exhibit 99.1; the 2025Q1 release is filed as an 8-K/A). The 2023Q1 release prints the prior-year column as a dash, so 2023Q1 is the first quarter of sales. The quarter is the one ended before the filing date and is confirmed by the prior-year comparative column.
Prior-year check: the prior-year comparative column of 10 quarterly quotes equals the figure recorded for that earlier quarter from its own filing.
